item.title: IRGC's 'larger than normal' presence poses challenge in search for missing F-15E crew member, expert warns
item.summary: Military expert says U.S. search and rescue for a missing F-15E crew member in Iran is complicated by a large IRGC presence in the crash region.

item.title: Cruise line abruptly adds extra charges for passengers as travelers worry others may follow
item.summary: Cruise passengers fear retroactive charges as oil prices surge 40% since the Iran conflict, with cruise lines' fine print allowing added fees. Ticket prices could rise too.

item.title: Dogs were 'loyal companions to Ice Age hunters' far earlier than believed, study finds
item.summary: Pushing back the domestication timeline by 5,000 years via ancient DNA, a new study suggests that dogs lived with humans 14,000 to 16,000 years ago.

item.title: 6 jaw-dropping food heists that came before the massive 12-ton KitKat theft
item.summary: From KitKat bars to maple syrup and olive oil, organized criminals are increasingly targeting food shipments in costly and sophisticated cargo thefts.

item.title: Georgetown University to offer pornography course to students
item.summary: Georgetown University will offer a pornography course this fall examining pornography production and "the pornographic" in contemporary media, culture, and social conflicts.

item.title: Trump unveils $1.5T defense surge, deep domestic cuts — what’s on the budget chopping block
item.summary: The White House proposes a fiscal year 2027 budget with roughly $1.5 trillion in defense spending and sweeping cuts to key domestic programs.

item.title: James Carville goes on profanity-laced Trump tirade, says he hopes president doesn’t ‘croak’ before midterms
item.summary: James Carville scorches Trump in a profanity-laced YouTube rant, questioning his fitness for office and taunting his declining approval poll numbers.

item.title: WWE NXT champ Jacy Jayne ready for call-up, puts women's division on notice
item.summary: NXT women's champion Jacy Jayne says years ago she would have floundered on the main roster, but now she feels ready to take a spot from the best in WWE.

item.title: JONATHAN TURLEY: Kamala Harris backs radical plan to block Trump SCOTUS picks
item.summary: Former Vice President Kamala Harris is rallying Democratic donors to oppose potential Trump Supreme Court nominees through the group Demand Justice.

item.title: UConn's undefeated season crumbles as South Carolina gets sweet revenge against reigning champs
item.summary: South Carolina ended UConn's 54-game winning streak with a 62-48 Final Four victory, outscoring the Huskies by 16 points in the final 20 minutes.
